question.text: Which of the following statements is incorrect regarding physissorptions ?

options.text: It occurs because of vander Waal's forces.
More easily liquefiable gases are adsorbed readily.
Under high pressure it results into multi molecular layer on adsorbent surface.
Enthalpy of adsorption $\left(\Delta \mathrm{H}_{\text {adsorption }}\right)$ is low and positive.

solution.text: Enthalpy of adsorption regarding physissorption is not positive and it is negative.
